passives.name: Survival Instinct
passives.description: (Passive Effect) Damage dealt increases if the attack target has Poison, or if Dek’Ril has a Buff. When an enemy uses an AoE skill excluding Skill Chains, all allies’ Defense increases for [Buff_T_4076003_13_2] turns. WG damage taken from non-Fire enemies is reduced by [Buff_V_armor_common_1], and damage dealt increases while damage taken decreases. Damage dealt to Fire enemies decreases, and damage taken increases. (Trigger Effect) After an enemy acts, if the target is affected by Poisoned, restores [Buff_V_4076003_11_2] WG and immediately counterattacks with Atlas. Damage from Curse/Fixed Damage dealt to bosses cannot exceed [Buff_V_armor_common_3].

buffs.summary: +15% damage to boss if attacker has element advantage
−50% damage to boss if attacker has element disadvantage
−50% damage to boss if attacker has no element advantage/disadvantage
